title: Charge-Trap Memory with Engineered Temporal Dynamics for Physically Integrated Reservoir Computing.
abstract: 2D material (2DM)-based reservoir computing (RC) systems combine the advantages of low-power hardware implementation with lightweight neural network architectures capable of processing complex temporal patterns through minimal training overhead, positioning them as ideal platforms for edge artificial intelligence (AI) applications.
